items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 19 July 2026 4:16am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 19 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Fine today with good sunny spells, although areas of high cloud may make the sunshine hazy at times. Light or moderate winds for much of the day, then freshening from the northwest this evening; top temperature 20°C.


##Outlook##

Staying dry through the working week, with moderate to fresh winds and nearer average temperatures, then at some point next weekend the drought period is likely to finish.
